Unauthorized.description: No credential, an unknown X-Api-Key, or an invalid/expired Bearer token (or one whose user maps to no active tenant). The message never says which.

ComposerQuery.description: Metric × dimension composition over one continuous aggregate.

dimensions.description: Group-by dimensions, returned as columns of the same name.

grain.description: Bucket size; picks the aggregate and its max window (1min: 7 days, 1hour: 90 days).

metrics.description: Metrics to aggregate (sums of increments; avg_speed is an average).

to.description: Window end, RFC 3339 (exclusive); must be after `from`.

DatasetQuery.description: Named-dataset request. The set of names and each one's filters are listed by GET /v1/catalog.

filters.description: Per-dataset filters (GET /v1/catalog → datasets[name].filters): id lists as integer arrays, single ids as integers, enums as lower-case strings, booleans, dates as strings.

window.description: Required for windowed datasets, rejected otherwise. Bounds accept YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or RFC 3339; the span must fit the dataset's max_window.

ErrorText.description: http.Error body: a one-line JSON object followed by a newline, served as `text/plain; charset=utf-8`.

equipment.description: Optional id_equipment filter; empty ⇒ all of the tenant's equipment.

to.description: Window end, RFC 3339 (exclusive); at most ~5 years after `from`.

Rows.description: Result rows as JSON objects; the columns are whatever the backing view/function returns.

ApiKey.description: Operator/service key (QUERY_API_KEYS key:customer_id map, auth.go). Authoritative when present: a bad key 401s, no Bearer fallback.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key

CognitoBearer.description: Cognito ID token (COGNITO_ISSUER / COGNITO_CLIENT_ID). The tenant and user role come from the users row linked to the token (auth_firebase.go, auth_cognito.go). Used when no X-Api-Key is sent.

ExternalApiKeyHeader.description: Foreign-contract shims (external.go headerAPIKeyAuth): same QUERY_API_KEYS map, but the key must resolve to the shim's bound owner. Missing → 400, unknown/other tenant → 401, text/html.
ExternalApiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key

ExternalApiKeyQuery.description: Foreign-contract shims that take the key as a query param (queryAPIKeyAuth, /integration/* ladders). Same map, owner-bound.
ExternalApiKeyQuery.name: api_key

InternalKey.description: Shared service secret (INTERNAL_API_KEY, internal.go). Unset ⇒ every request 401s.
InternalKey.name: X-Internal-Key

info.description:
Packiot read plane: the Hasura-replacement operator reads, the composable query API (named datasets + metric × dimension composer), per-user layouts, the historian (hot + cold archive) reach, a service-to-service resolver, and frozen foreign-contract shims for ERP/BI integrations. Everything here is read-only except the per-user screen layout (`PUT /v1/screen-config`).

## How to call this API

- **Auth** — tenant routes take `X-Api-Key: <api-key>` (service/operator keys) **or** `Authorization: Bearer <cognito-id-token>` (front4 users). The tenant is always derived from the credential, never from the request. When both are sent, `X-Api-Key` wins and a bad key is a 401 (no Bearer fallback). The `/ext/*` and `/integration/*` shims authenticate themselves with an integration key (`x-api-key` header or `api_key` query parameter, per operation) bound to one tenant; `/internal/*` takes `X-Internal-Key`.
- **Operator super-admin (dark unless OPERATOR_SUPERADMIN_CROSS_TENANT_ENABLED)** — a verified super-admin may read another tenant by sending `x-operator-superadmin-token: <cognito-id-token>` plus `?idEnterprise=<target>` alongside the normal credential; any failed check silently keeps the home tenant.
- **Base URLs** — see `servers`: `https://refdata.staging.packiot.app` (staging), `https://refdata.prod.packiot.app` (production, behind CloudFront), `http://localhost:9104` (local dev). `/openapi.json` and `/metrics` are not routed publicly; fetch the spec from the portal.
- **Content types** — request bodies are `application/json` (≤ 64 KB; longer bodies are cut at 64 KB and then fail to parse). Successful responses are `application/json`; most are an array of row objects whose columns are the backing SQL object's (examples are abridged).
- **Errors** — native routes answer `text/plain; charset=utf-8` whose body is a one-line JSON object plus a newline, e.g. `{"error":"query failed"}`. Parse it as JSON if you like, but do not rely on the Content-Type. The shims reproduce back4 byte-for-byte: plain-string bodies served as `text/html; charset=utf-8`. 401 messages never say which credential failed.
- **Docs** — the read-only Swagger UI portal is https://api.staging.packiot.app/docs/ (cs-admin SSO). The same document is exported to `docs/api/openapi/read-api.openapi.json` in packiot-stack-alpha (`make openapi`; `refdata-api --dump-openapi`).

post.description:
Two body shapes share the route.

- **Named dataset** — a body with `dataset` runs one allowlisted query from the registry (GET /v1/catalog lists names, windows and filters). Unknown filters or out-of-enum values are rejected; the shared row cap is applied. Results are cached per tenant + query for a short TTL (Redis cache-aside, fail-open), so identical polls within the TTL return the same bytes. Coverage headers say how far back the dataset's hot data reaches.
- **Composer** — `metrics` × `dimensions` over a continuous aggregate at `grain` for [`from`, `to`), at most 10000 rows; never cached. A window older than the aggregate's retention is a 422 pointing at /v1/historian/*.

Body ≤ 64 KB. 40 s query timeout. Tenant-scoped like every native route (the tenant is never read from the body). Datasets flagged `requires_user_context` need a Bearer token. Any HTTP method is accepted; POST is the contract.

composer.summary: Composer: hourly net production per equipment

singleEquipmentDataset.summary: Dataset that requires one equipment id

200.description: Rows as JSON objects (an empty array when nothing matches). Dataset columns are the backing object's; composer columns are `ts_value`, the requested dimensions, then the metrics.

Warning.description: Dataset path only: a 299 warning accompanying X-Data-Truncated, naming the floor and where deep history lives.
Warning.example: 299 read-api "window starts before 2026-07-15T00:00:00Z: silver.equipment_values keeps 90 days; older rows are not in this dataset (deep history: /v1/historian/*)"

X-Data-Hot-Floor.description: Dataset path only: the oldest timestamp the dataset still holds (RFC 3339, UTC).

X-Data-Truncated.description: Dataset path only: `true` when the window starts before the hot floor (older rows are missing).

400.description: Malformed body, or the request fails validation (unknown dataset/metric/dimension/grain/filter, bad window, window over budget).

text/plain.example: {"error":"dataset requires user context (front4 Firebase JWT); not available via X-Api-Key"}

403.description: A per-user-role dataset (`requires_user_context`) was called without a user identity (X-Api-Key, or a user without a role).

text/plain.example: {"error":"window starts before 2026-07-15T00:00:00Z: agg_equipment_values_1hour keeps 90 days; for older data use /v1/historian/production-series"}

422.description: Composer only: the window starts before the aggregate's retention floor.

500.description: The query failed or timed out (40 s).
